channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Govt procures record 1.92 crore metric tonnes of pulses: Agriculture Minister
item.description: Chouhan noted that while India had 38 per cent of the global area under pulses cultivation, its share in production was only 28 per cent, reflecting low productivity due to old seed varieties, low seed replacement rates and adverse weather.

item.title: Nifty, Sensex decline as AI concerns weigh on IT sector
item.description: Nifty lost 0.87 per cent during the week and dipped 1.30 per cent on the last trading day to 25,471. At Friday's close, the Sensex was down 1,048 points or 1.25 per cent at 82,626. It declined 1.14 per cent during the week.

item.title: PM Modi pays tribute to Pulwama martyrs, remembers their valour and sacrifice
item.description: In a post on X, PM Modi posted, "Remembering the brave heroes who laid down their lives in Pulwama on this day in 2019. Their devotion, resolve and service to the nation remain forever etched in our collective consciousness. Every Indian draws strength from their enduring courage."

item.title: Tech leaders, governments push AI-cybersecurity partnership between India and Israel
item.description: The India–Israel AI-Cybersecurity Connect, held February 11 in Palo Alto, drew more than 130 founders, venture capitalists, and cybersecurity experts. The event was hosted by the Consulate General of India in San Francisco, the Consulate General of Israel, and Venture Dock.

item.title: Couple Friendly movie review: Audience describe it as beautiful story of love, loss and goodbyes
item.description: Director Ashwin Chandrasekhar's Telugu movie Couple Friendly starring Santhosh Sobhan and Manasa Varanasi, has received positive reviews and ratings from the audience.

item.title: There won't be anything like Naatu Naatu in Varanasi: SS Rajamouli
item.description: Director SS Rajamouli says that his highly-anticipated movie Varanasi will have great music, great songs, but there won't be anything like Naatu Naatu.

item.title: Arjun Sarja says Vishwak Sen was first choice for the role played by Niranjana in Seetha Payanam
item.description: Director Arjun Sarja revealed that Vishwak Sen was the first choice for the role played by Niranjana in Seetha Payanam, but he walked out of the project due to the difference of opinion.

item.title: O Romeo movie review: Audience describe it as Stylish, Intense and Impactful
item.description: Director Vishal Bhardwaj's Hindi movie O Romeo starring Shahid Kapoor and Triptii Dimri has received positive reviews and decent ratings from the audience.

item.title: Hardik Pandya's GF Mahieka gifts him rose bouquet; fan in Virat jersey breaches security to meet him amid India vs NAM match
item.description: During the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026 clash between India and Namibia at Arun Jaitley Stadium, a fan in a Virat Kohli jersey breached security and ran toward Hardik Pandya before being swiftly removed. While off-field, ahead of Valentine's Day and girlfriend Mahieka Sharma's birthday week, the couple celebrated in Delhi.

item.title: Nothing opens 5,000 sq ft flagship store in Bengaluru; eyes deeper India push
item.description: The opening comes as Nothing continues to expand its global retail presence following its Soho, London store, with additional flagship outlets planned in cities such as New York and Tokyo.
